observation.visible_scene: An overcast seascape with a gray horizon and a band of white foam in the foreground. A single surfer in a dark wetsuit on a pale surfboard is positioned mid-frame on the face of a breaking wave, with a plume of spray rising behind them.
visible_changes: The surfer starts lying prone on the board, partially obscured by churning spray, and over the sequence pushes up into a crouch and then stands upright on the board.
The spray plume that initially surrounds the surfer gradually subsides as the surfer rises and gains a stable stance.

The breaking white water of the wave grows and spreads from the right side of the crest toward the center, while the surfer holds a roughly central horizontal position, riding along the wave face with knees bent and arms extended for balance.

The foreground foam band and the horizon remain largely steady throughout, indicating the main motion is the surfer's transition from prone to standing and the wave's breaking, not a large camera shift.
outside_clip_unknowns: How the surfer caught and began riding this wave before the first frame (the action is already underway at t=0).
Whether the ride continues successfully or ends after the last frame.
uncertain_details: Exact board color/shape is hard to resolve at this distance and lighting.
Whether there is any slight camera pan versus a fixed framing is not fully determinable from the background alone.
The surfer's paddle strokes (if any) during the prone phase are not clearly distinguishable from the surrounding spray.
